'''Fire Plants''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Plant/Legends|plant]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]]. They bore a striking similarity to the [[Ice Plant]]s found on the ice planet [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]].<ref name="SEMP" />
